sentences.en: Such conduct would subject the offender to a heavy penalty.
sentences.zh: 这种行为会使罪犯受到严厉的惩罚。

sentences.en: He even suspected that the man was the principal offender.
sentences.zh: 他甚至怀疑这个男人是主要的犯罪者。

sentences.en: Sami was sent to a boot camp for young offenders.
sentences.zh: 塞米被送到了一个针对年轻违法者的训练营。
